text:
carmen: quick heads up, noticed multiple fncall schema rejects this morning hitting fallback; console shows quota usage but no reject reasons.

raj: saw it too. logs show `validator=v3` rejects with message 'ARRAY_INSTEAD_OF_OBJECT' but route header missing in telemetry. sample: `{"tool":"geo_lookup","result":["lat","lon"]}` expected `{"location":{"lat":number}}`.

elda: that router change to collapse headers on fallback is biting us. we lose X-Route-ID when degen path used.

mike: proposal: router should copy X-Route-ID into the fallback metadata earlier. small patch. also validator should emit `validation.code` and `validation.hint` in the reject event.

carmen: agree. also add a light sampling preview in Console (per-route toggle) so PMs can inspect rejects without billing.

raj: billing note: we can't retroactively prove non-billable unless we either route preview traffic to a non-bill plan id or emit `billing.credit` events later. ops prefers non-bill plan routing.

elda: non-bill plan easier to account for. we need guard rails so customers don't accidentally use it for prod. require owner approval + rate cap.

mike: action items: (1) router patch to persist route id (owner: elda), (2) validator emit code+hint (owner: raj), (3) Console preview toggle that routes to preview plan when enabled (owner: carmen), (4) ops/finance call to finalize billing (owner: finance).

ops-bot: Upcoming deploy deploy-2026-03-20-99 revert window 3h 40m.

carmen: I'll mock the Console preview UI and add redaction rules for payload snippets. keep retention at 7 days by default.

raj: I'll add the ENUM for validation.code and short human hints. will keep field names flat for metrics: `fncall.validation.reject`, `fncall.validation.code`, `fncall.validation.hint`, `route_id`.

elda: starting router branch now. will add tests to assert header persists across fallback.

mike: let's block the global strict flip until these land. tagging release owners.

carmen: +1

raj: +1
